# TASA Trust

> TASA Trust Pte. Ltd. provides Singapore virtual office, corporate secretary, accounting, tax, and compliance services for businesses.

TASA Trust helps companies establish and operate in Singapore with a professional business address, mail handling, bookkeeping, payroll, GST and corporate tax filing, and company secretarial support. Plans are available monthly or annual, with optional add-on services billed one-time or recurring.

## Startup Kit

- [Startup Kit](/startup-kit): Bundled hub for founders — register a Singapore company, appoint a corporate secretary, secure a registered address, stay tax-compliant, and launch a website.
- [Register a Company in Singapore](/startup-kit/register-company-singapore): ACRA Pte Ltd incorporation guide and service.
- [Foreigner Setup Guide](/startup-kit/foreigner-guide): How non-residents can fully own and incorporate a Singapore company.
- [Corporate Secretary](/startup-kit/corporate-secretary): Mandatory corporate secretarial service for Singapore Pte Ltds.
- [Registered Address](/startup-kit/registered-address): ACRA-accepted Singapore registered office address with mail handling.
- [Accounting, Tax & GST](/startup-kit/accounting-tax): Bookkeeping, GST, and corporate tax filing for startups.
- [Website & Branding](/startup-kit/website-branding): Launch-ready website and brand kit bundled with incorporation.
